## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [支施崙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E6%96%BD%E5%B4%99) Zhī Shīlún is the second Chinese version of the *Surata-paripṛcchā*, parallel to [Báiyán's earlier T0328](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0020). The two-translation tradition documents the early Chinese reception of the *paripṛcchā* sūtra and provides important comparative-philological material.

**Abstract**

The translation is conventionally placed in the Former-Liáng period (314 – 376 CE). The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The Taishō text (T0329) is established on the standard apparatus.
